_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#4, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. The headline is TRUE (InteriorFacetBasis is single-sided; side=0 -> f2t[0], side=1 -> f2t[1]; the jump comes from asm(form,[i0,i1],[i0,i1])), but three details are FALSE: it visits each interior facet ONCE (nelems = 40 = n_interior_facets on MeshTri().refined(2)), u.other does not exist, and the verbatim FEniCSx port is not a factor-of-2 error. skfem.helpers.jump returns its args unchanged when w has no idx, which is what a single-basis form.assemble(i0) gives, so the operator stops being a jump: it is nonzero on a continuous field and has zero inter-element coupling, and no scalar multiple relates it to the correct one.
